CommunityApplications.Profile: GoatMediaStackarr: a whole media stack in one container. Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr, Prowlarr, Bazarr, qBittorrent, SABnzbd, Jellyfin and Seerr (plus optional Tautulli, Plex and FlareSolverr), connected to each other on first start, behind one interface and one login, with a built-in VPN and kill switch for the download apps. Made by bdlnaredi, who also makes MediaHub. Questions and problems: open an issue on GitHub.
